clue.text: Sarcastic piece from the newspaper

explanation.surface: A barbed bit of journalism clipped from a paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutting remarks are wounding or biting, and a press clipping is also called a cutting.

clue.text: Travel regularly to-reduce the sentence

explanation.surface: A convict hoping travel will shorten his punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: To commute is to make a daily journey to work, and also to lessen a judicial penalty.

clue.text: Presumed to have stolen the statue

explanation.surface: Someone thought to have stolen a monument.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking the liberty is acting presumptuously, and the Statue of Liberty is New York's famous monument.

clue.text: Not I moving to a position within

indicators.note: moving means the letters of not i are shifted about

explanation.surface: Someone declining to relocate somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Into is a preposition of motion meaning entering inside.

clue.text: Gleam of fancy singlet

indicators.note: fancy suggests the singlet is dressed up, its letters made over

explanation.surface: The shine of a decorative vest.
explanation.definitionFit: To glisten is to shine with a wet sparkle.

clue.text: Brown cassava first found in Mexican state

indicators.note: first tells us the cassava word goes at the front, before the colour

parts.note: yuca is another name for the cassava plant
tan is a light brown colour

explanation.surface: Brown cassava roots turning up first in some region of Mexico.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' sets the order: the cassava comes before the colour, though the clue mentions the colour first.
explanation.definitionFit: The Yucatan is a state on the peninsula of the same name in south-east Mexico.

clue.text: Food from the trough after end of May

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held: 'Food from the trough after end of May (7)'. Y (end of May) + OGHURT, an anagram of TROUGH, but no word signals the anagram; an indicator seems lost in OCR.
annotationWithheld.clue: Food from the trough after end of May

clue.text: Firm about one of two Andean shrub

parts.note: Co is short for company, a firm
ca, circa, means about

explanation.surface: A company dealing in a South American plant.
explanation.walkthrough: There are two cultivated coca species, hence 'one of two'; 'shrub' is read as shrubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Coca is a South American bush whose leaves yield cocaine.

clue.text: Impossible to know secret's being kept

explanation.surface: Nobody can say, because a confidence is being kept.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means nobody can predict, and also no one is revealing anything.

clue.text: Hesitantly five having commonsense go round in a jumpy state

indicators.note: go round says the commonsense word surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: nous is common sense
er is the sound made when hesitating
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: Someone sensible circling five times in an anxious state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hesitantly' is not an adverb here: it stands for the hesitation sound a speaker makes.
explanation.definitionFit: Nervous means anxious and on edge.

clue.text: Explain what glasses do for their owner

definitions.text: what glasses do for their owner

explanation.surface: Explaining something compared to what spectacles do for a wearer.
explanation.definitionFit: To explain is to clarify a matter, and spectacles literally sharpen the wearer's view of objects.

clue.text: Skeletal part of a delightful narrative

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A bony fragment of a charming story.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across delightfUL NArrative; 'Skeletal' stands for a bone of the skeleton.
explanation.definitionFit: The ulna is one of the two long bones of the forearm, part of the human skeleton.

clue.text: Full bodied drink

explanation.surface: A beer described as rich and full-bodied.
explanation.definitionFit: Stout means portly or heavily built, and it is also a dark, strong beer.

clue.text: Don't allow doctor round

parts.note: a vet is an animal doctor
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A patient refusing to let the doctor make a visit.
explanation.definitionFit: To veto is to forbid or block a proposal.

clue.text: Spicy hitch?

explanation.surface: A question about a hot-tasting snag.
explanation.definitionFit: A clove is a pungent spice bud, and a clove hitch is a common sailing knot.

clue.text: Oil found by Jack at first

indicators.note: first says the little word at goes at the front, ahead of the sailor

parts.note: taken as written
Jack tar is an old term for a sailor, shortened to tar

explanation.surface: Oil discovered by a man named Jack at the outset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jack' as a name misleads: Jack and tar are both slang for a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: Attar is a fragrant essential oil pressed from rose petals.

clue.text: Another lone revolutionary inside part of the hierarchy

indicators.note: inside places the revolutionary within the rearranged word
another lone means a different version of the word lone, its letters rearranged

parts.note: Che Guevara, the Argentine revolutionary

explanation.surface: A second solitary rebel infiltrates the ranks of an organisation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another' turns the word lone into ELON, and 'inside' splits that after its first letter to take Guevara.
explanation.definitionFit: An echelon is a level or rank within an organisation's structure.

clue.text: Unseat another model first having a complaint

indicators.note: first puts the model letter at the front

parts.note: the Model T was Ford's famous car, so model gives T

indicators.note: another version of the word unseat means its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A rider thrown from a different model of horse ends up with an ailment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' makes ETANUS from the first word; 'Unseat' looks like a riding fall but is only fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Tetanus is a bacterial illness, and complaint is a common word for an ailment.

clue.text: Nothing's in the mattress, dear

indicators.note: in says the word for nothing goes inside the mattress word

parts.note: a bed, standing for the mattress
love means a score of nothing in tennis

explanation.surface: Someone addressing a partner about nothing being in the mattress.
explanation.walkthrough: In tennis scoring 'love' is zero, so 'Nothing' gives LOVE.
explanation.definitionFit: A beloved is a sweetheart, someone held dear.

clue.text: Notice in the noisy quarrel a small boring tool

indicators.note: in places the notice inside the word for a fight

parts.note: a brawl is a noisy fight or quarrel
an ad is a notice, an advertisement

explanation.surface: Spotting a little dull implement during a loud row.
explanation.definitionFit: A bradawl is a small hand tool with a flat tip for making holes in wood.

clue.text: Cook sea-fish?

parts.note: the deep is a poetic word for the sea
fry are young fish

explanation.surface: An instruction to cook seafood.
explanation.definitionFit: To deep-fry is to cook food submerged in hot fat.

clue.text: Medico has a staff shortage that's severe

parts.note: Dr is short for doctor, a medico

indicators.note: shortage says the staff word comes up short of its final letter

parts.note: a stick is a staff

explanation.surface: A hospital doctor complains of a severe lack of personnel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'staff shortage' looks like missing workers, but it is STICK cut short to STIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Drastic measures are extreme or harsh in their effect.

clue.text: Handy to include here in France a shortfall

indicators.note: to include says the handy word wraps round the French word

parts.note: deft means skilful, handy
ici is French for here

explanation.surface: A useful way to report a French shortfall.
explanation.definitionFit: A deficit is an amount by which something falls short.

clue.text: Many an Italian region found in England!

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many
Umbria is a region of central Italy

explanation.surface: A remark that many an Italian district has its counterpart in England.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the place itself, found in England: Cumbria is the county of the Lake District in north-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Cumbria is a county in the far north-west of the country, home to the Lake District.

clue.text: Cleric be after Jack

indicators.note: after puts the word be behind the sailor

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor, as is a jack
taken as written

explanation.surface: A priest following a man named Jack.
explanation.definitionFit: An abbe is a French title for a priest or clergyman.

clue.text: Strong as an ox

explanation.surface: Someone as strong as an ox.
explanation.definitionFit: Beefy means brawny and muscular, and beef comes from an ox.

clue.text: Most of the gluey mud is thin

indicators.note: most of the word for gluey mud, so all but its final letter

parts.note: slime is gluey, slippery mud

explanation.surface: The sticky mud is mostly of a thin consistency.
explanation.definitionFit: Slim means slender, of small width.

clue.text: A rally beginning at sea

indicators.note: beginning says the letters come from the start of the words a rally

explanation.surface: A rally getting under way out on the water.
explanation.walkthrough: The run is A RALly, the opening letters of the phrase; the Aral Sea is in Central Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: The Aral is an inland sea between Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.

clue.text: Three islands in Ireland, sounds like one in Scotland

indicators.note: sounds like says a spoken word gives the entry

parts.note: Arran is an island in the Firth of Clyde in Scotland

explanation.surface: Comparing an Irish island group with a Scottish island.
explanation.definitionFit: The Aran Islands are a group of three off Galway Bay on the west coast.

clue.text: Ship or plane transporter

explanation.surface: A vessel that carries jets.
explanation.definitionFit: This warship serves as a floating airfield for jets.

clue.text: Faithfulness-to the crown?

parts.note: describes the allegiance a subject owes to the monarch

explanation.surface: Asking about devotion to the monarchy.
explanation.definitionFit: Loyalty is steadfast allegiance, especially to a sovereign.

clue.text: Nathan returned Indian city figurine

indicators.note: returned says the short form of the name is read backwards

parts.note: Nat is a short form of Nathan
Agra, the Indian city of the Taj Mahal

explanation.surface: A man named Nathan came back from an Indian city with a statuette.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tanagra is a small terracotta statuette from ancient Greece, named after the town where they were found.
